title: Sohail Khan Takes Responsibility for Divorce From Seema Sajdeh on National Television
excerpt: The former couple appeared together on Prime Video's reality show Alliance, where Sohail publicly acknowledged his role in the breakdown of their 25-year relationship.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Sohail Khan and Seema Sajdeh discussed their divorce on Prime Video's reality show Alliance.
  • Sohail took responsibility for their marital issues, stating, 'I take the onus and the responsibility.'
  • The couple was married for nearly 25 years and share two sons, Nirvaan and Yohan.
  • Seema joined the show as a wildcard contestant, paired with Sohail for a segment.
  • Public reaction praised Sohail for his accountability, highlighting its rarity in Bollywood.
A 25-Year Journey
›Married in 1998
›Divorced in 2022
›Publicly acknowledged marital issues on Alliance
›Share two sons: Nirvaan and Yohan

In an unusually candid moment for a Bollywood family known for its privacy, Sohail Khan publicly acknowledged his role in the breakdown of his marriage to Seema Sajdeh during an appearance on Prime Video's reality show Alliance.

"I Take the Onus"

The former couple, who divorced in 2022 after nearly 25 years of marriage, were paired together on the show, hosted by actor Kunal Kemmu. Seema had entered as a wildcard contestant.

https://x.com/dna/status/2079189581333979554

When the conversation turned to their past relationship, Sohail was uncharacteristically direct. "Lovely. I have lived with this beautiful lady for 25 years," he said, addressing the audience. "Let me admit on national television that if there was any mistake between us, I take the onus and the responsibility."

The statement was notable both for its content and its context. The Khan family — Sohail is the youngest brother of Salman Khan — has historically maintained a strict boundary between its public and private lives. The divorce itself was handled quietly, with neither party making public statements about the reasons behind it.

"I have lived with this beautiful lady for 25 years. Let me admit on national television that if there was any mistake between us, I take the onus and the responsibility."

— Sohail Khan on Alliance

From Marriage to Reality TV

Sohail and Seema married in 1998. Their relationship and eventual separation became a subject of public curiosity during Seema's earlier appearance on Netflix's Fabulous Lives of Bollywood Wives, where she appeared to hint at marital difficulties. The divorce was finalised in September 2022 by mutual consent.

The couple share two sons: Nirvaan, who has been making his own moves in entertainment, and younger son Yohan.

""Let me admit on national television that if there was any mistake between us, I take the onus and the responsibility."</p><p>The statement was notable both for its content and its context."

Public Response

Social media reaction to the clip was largely positive, with many praising Sohail for his willingness to accept accountability publicly. Others pointed out the rarity of a male Bollywood figure taking such a stance, particularly from within a family as prominent as the Khans.

Whether the reality show appearance signals a genuine reconciliation effort or simply makes for compelling television remains to be seen.
